description: Restyle the dashboard shell and the read/simple pages to shadcn/ui: layout + nav + status badge, overview, reviews, bookings page + table, settings. Presentation only — preserve requireOwnerBusiness authorization, all server data loading and actions, native inputs, i18n keys, and every accessibility attribute. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs components/ui/* and the dark variant). Independent of FEAT-003 in scope, but executes after it is not required; run sequentially in the one shared worktree.
steps: Shell: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/layout.tsx and components/dashboard-nav.tsx. Use shadcn Sidebar if it cleanly fits the existing RSC server-layout + next-intl Link + usePathname active-state pattern; otherwise fall back to Card + the existing restyled <nav> (log the fallback in docs/shortcuts.md). Keep: business.name heading, <BusinessStatusBadge status={business.status}/>, the PUBLISHED-only 'view public page' Link to /b/{slug} with ExternalLink icon, the exact DASHBOARD_NAV item list and routes, the desktop-sidebar / mobile-grid responsive split, aria-current, aria-label on the nav, and 44px (min-h-11) targets. Replace HIG arbitrary classes (bg-[color:var(--tint)], rounded-[var(--radius-button)], text-[color:var(--label)]) with shadcn/Tailwind utilities.

components/business-status-badge.tsx: keep the icon-per-status + text pattern (never colour alone) using shadcn Badge or tokenized classes; keep the dashboard.status i18n keys and the four statuses (DRAFT/PENDING/PUBLISHED/SUSPENDED).

Overview: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx keeping all four status branches (DRAFT checklist + SubmitForReviewForm, PENDING/SUSPENDED messaging, PUBLISHED today/week stat tiles). Convert the stat tiles to shadcn Card. Keep PublishChecklistView, SubmitForReviewForm, the db.booking.count queries and the dashboard.overview i18n keys unchanged.

Reviews page: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/reviews/page.tsx — summary card, star rating + distribution bars (keep the aria-labels and the sr-only heading), filter chips -> shadcn Button/Badge with aria-current, review list items -> shadcn Card. Keep OwnerReplyForm and ReportReviewButton wiring, loadReviewsForDashboard, reviewsHref pagination, and reviewsManage i18n keys. Do not restyle the shared/public review-form.tsx.

Bookings: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/bookings/page.tsx (status filter chips, the plain method=get filter form, pagination nav) and components/bookings/bookings-table.tsx (desktop <table> via shadcn Table, mobile cards, StatusBadge/SourceBadge via shadcn Badge). Stop importing inputClass/primaryBtn from components/calendar/fields for the dashboard markup here; use shadcn Input/Select/Button/Table/Badge. KEEP native <input type="date"> (b-from/b-to), <input type="search"> (b-q), the <select> for staff/sort, the hidden status input, maxLength, autoComplete, the table <caption>/scope=col/scope=row/aria-label semantics, the changeBookingStatus action, and BookingDetails/ConfirmSheet/FormSheet wiring. i18n keys (bookings, calendar) unchanged.

Settings: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/settings/page.tsx, components/settings/booking-rules-form.tsx, components/settings/unpublish-button.tsx with shadcn Card/Input/Label/Button. Keep BusinessStatusBadge, PublishChecklistView, SubmitForReviewForm, the server actions, and the settings i18n keys. unpublish-button uses the SHARED components/manage/confirm-sheet.tsx — do not change that shared sheet's API or its visual contract for account/admin; only restyle unpublish-button's own trigger/markup.
error.tsx: leave app/[locale]/dashboard/error.tsx delegating to the shared ErrorState; do NOT restyle components/error-state.tsx (used by admin/error and root error).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard layout, nav, overview, reviews, bookings and settings render with the shadcn look and no remaining var(--text-*)/var(--radius-*)/var(--label*)/var(--tint) arbitrary classes in the edited dashboard files (grep the edited files for `var(--` returns nothing except intentionally kept brand/native-input cases).
Active nav item still shows aria-current and highlights; icon-only buttons retain aria-label; status/aria-live regions and table caption/scope semantics are intact.
No change to requireOwnerBusiness, DASHBOARD_NAV routes, server actions, data loaders, or i18n keys; no new message keys (or any new key added to all three locales).
Shared components (calendar/fields.tsx, manage/confirm-sheet.tsx, error-state.tsx, focus-heading.tsx) are not restyled in place; admin/account/public appearance is unchanged.
Native date/search/select inputs on the bookings page remain native.
verification: git diff --name-only : confirm only in-scope dashboard files (plus FEAT-001 foundation files) changed; no app/[locale]/b/**, admin/**, account/**, auth, lib/**, or app/actions/** files.
findings: Restyled the dashboard shell (layout + dashboard-nav + business-status-badge), overview, reviews, bookings page + bookings-table, and settings (settings page + booking-rules-form + unpublish-button) to shadcn/ui. Presentation-only: requireOwnerBusiness, DASHBOARD_NAV routes, server actions, data loaders, native <input type=date|search>/<select>, hidden status input, maxLength/autoComplete, table caption/scope semantics, aria-current, aria-label, role=status/aria-live, aria-invalid/aria-describedby all preserved. Shared components (calendar/fields.tsx, manage/confirm-sheet.tsx, error-state.tsx, focus-heading.tsx) untouched; dashboard/error.tsx still delegates to ErrorState. No message keys added. SHORTCUT: used Card + restyled <nav> instead of shadcn <Sidebar> (RSC/next-intl/usePathname fit; logged in docs/shortcuts.md). Added --color-success/--color-tint/--color-tint-contrast to the @theme inline map in globals.css so success/tint utilities resolve in the restyled dashboard while HIG tokens stay for public/admin/account. booking-rules-form now has a local shadcn Field wrapper (keeps fieldAria aria wiring). bookings-table StatusBadge/SourceBadge use shadcn Badge (icon + tone, cancelled = line-through). Verification all green: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit (0 errors), pnpm lint (only a pre-existing unrelated warning in app/actions/auth.ts), pnpm check:messages (in sync), pnpm test lib/bookings-params.test.ts lib/reviews.test.ts lib/publish-checklist.test.ts (25 passed), pnpm build (all locales prerendered). git diff touches only in-scope dashboard files + app/globals.css; no b/**, admin/**, account/**, auth, lib/**, or app/actions/** files. node binary not invoked.
